system.summary: Thrown weapons and objects get +30 ft Range, and you get +1 Talent Die on Strikes with them.

automation.note: Thrown weapons get +30 ft Range automatically; add it yourself for objects that aren't Thrown weapons. The +1 Talent Die is automatic for Thrown weapons; when throwing an object that isn't one, add the Talent Die in the roll dialog. The system also counts Traps as thrown: untick the die for a deployed trap.
